note: Plain-English descriptions of the two audit pathways for the questionnaire result page. Written by the product owner for Readyline; NOT NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission text. The Commission's own description is in data/sources/types-of-audits.txt.
author: readyline

items.description: A desk-based review of your documents by an approved auditor. Usually the quicker audit, and usually the cheaper one, because there is no site visit.
A full audit: document review, a site visit, and interviews with your workers and some participants. Followed by a mid-term audit about 18 months after registration.
